title: Intrapartum Fever: Antibiotics Versus no Treatment
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether antibiotics can be safely avoided in women who develop a fever during labor. Because investigators have no accurate tests to determine whether women who develop fever during labor have intra-amniotic infection, antibiotics are often used to prevent spread of infection to the fetus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women between 34-42 weeks gestation
* Singleton fetus
* Admitted for labor management \& develops a fever of 100.4 F or greater

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known fetal anomaly
* Other indication for intrapartum antibiotics (endocarditis prophylaxis, other known maternal infection)
